cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY' 2>&1 | tail -40
import sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import analyze as AN, stress_feas as SF, z3
norm=AN.validate(SF.gen(4,mode='feasible'))
# reproduce one snapshot signature and time int vs real
L,coeff=AN._prepare(norm)
# get signatures by solving quickly? just use empty A with all obs relaxed? Instead use A=all observed domains -> few obs; approximate timing
snap=norm['snapshots'][0]
nc=len(norm['comm_ids']); ne=len(norm['edge_ids']); edges=norm['edges']
xs=[z3.Int('x%d'%i) for i in range(nc)]
cons=[]
for ci in range(nc):
    lo,hi=snap['bounds'][ci]; cons+=[xs[ci]>=lo,xs[ci]<=hi]
for e in range(ne):
    expr=AN._link_expr(xs,coeff,e,nc)
    if expr is not None: cons.append(expr<=L*edges[e]['capacity'])
for o in snap['observations']:
    expr=AN._obs_expr_L(norm,xs,coeff,L,0,o['metric'],o['target'])
    cons.append(z3.And(expr>=L*o['lo'],expr<=L*o['hi']))
# time 10 int max opts on demands
t=time.time()
for ci in range(12):
    o=z3.Optimize(); o.add(cons); h=o.maximize(xs[ci]); o.check(); o.model().eval(xs[ci])
print('12 int demand max opts',time.time()-t)
# real version
xr=[z3.Real('r%d'%i) for i in range(nc)]
consr=[]
for ci in range(nc):
    lo,hi=snap['bounds'][ci]; consr+=[xr[ci]>=lo,xr[ci]<=hi]
for e in range(ne):
    expr=AN._link_expr(xr,coeff,e,nc)
    if expr is not None: consr.append(expr<=L*edges[e]['capacity'])
for o in snap['observations']:
    expr=AN._obs_expr_L(norm,xr,coeff,L,0,o['metric'],o['target'])
    consr.append(z3.And(expr>=L*o['lo'],expr<=L*o['hi']))
t=time.time()
for ci in range(12):
    o=z3.Optimize(); o.add(consr); h=o.maximize(xr[ci]); o.check(); o.upper(h)
print('12 real demand max opts',time.time()-t)
